retrievalProfile.description: A hyper-realistic airbrushed illustration of a mischievous cherub with wings, juxtaposing innocent angelic features with rebellious adult habits against a soft sky background.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist vector art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, close-up portrait of a blonde, blue-eyed cherub with a single visible wing, leaning on a marble-like surface. The cherub has a knowing, slightly defiant expression, holding a cigarette in one hand while a pack of cigarettes sits on the ledge. The style is characterized by smooth, soft-focus airbrushing and a bright, hazy atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of angelic innocence and rebellious behavior
Soft, diffused lighting against sharp, detailed foreground objects
Warm skin tones contrasting with a cool, pale blue sky
Tight framing on the subject's face and upper torso
coreInvariants: The cherub must have a mischievous or knowing facial expression
The lighting must be soft and diffused, typical of 1980s airbrushing
The background must be a hazy, cloud-filled sky

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cherub is the dominant central figure, occupying approximately 80% of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cherub's eyes and the hand holding the cigarette serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the cherub's face, moves down to the hand and cigarette pack, and then follows the wing back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners as hazy sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones (peach, cream, tan) for the cherub's skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale sky blue for the background atmosphere.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red and white for the cigarette packaging and typography outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value with moderate saturation; the image feels bright and airy but with rich, blended shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly synthetic colors
Maintain a soft, pastel-adjacent sky palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with high-waisted crossbars
letterConstructionRules: Letters feature a strong vertical stress
Horizontal serifs are sharp and pronounced
Characters include a distinct internal inline or 'engraved' detail
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a high horizontal bar
The 'V' and 'N' have sharp, pointed terminals

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered on top of the background and subject

treatment.outline: Thick red outer stroke with thin black inner stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary metadata is presented in a clean, small Roman numeral format flanked by horizontal lines.
graphicDevices: Horizontal parallel lines framing secondary text
Internal inline strokes within the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and high-waisted feel.
Captures the condensed, high-impact display quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hyper-realistic airbrushed painting of a blonde cherub with one wing, leaning on a marble ledge, holding a cigarette, with a pack of cigarettes nearby, against a hazy blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a bold, red-outlined slab serif font with an internal inline detail at the top center. Add Roman numerals in a small serif font flanked by horizontal lines in the upper corners.

verificationChecks: Is the cherub's expression mischievous rather than purely innocent?
Does the typography have a distinct red outline and white fill?
Is the airbrush texture smooth and blended without visible brushstrokes?

adjustableVariables: Object on the ledge (e.g., replacing cigarettes with other items)
mustRedesign: Avoid direct replication of the specific band name or logo
Ensure the cherub's face is an original illustration and not a copy of the source
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the internal inline detail in the main text
Verify the soft-focus quality of the background sky
Ensure the cherub's wing has a feathered, realistic texture
Confirm the red outline on the text is thick and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrush Cherub + Slab Serif Display Type + Rebellious Juxtaposition
